item.title: WLCA Interview with Joe Litvag – Evolution Festival
item.description: Joe Litvag, Co-Founder and producer of the St. Louis Evolution Festival joins 89.9 to discuss this year’s event. Joe details how the festival came about and what it takes to plan and execute such a high-profile event. The music lineup, the food and drink, were also discussed.
